title: Solid-State Electrolyte Composition with Enhanced Ionic Conductivity
abstract: A solid-state electrolyte comprising a lithium-stuffed garnet oxide with formula Li7-xLa3Zr2-xTaxO12 achieving ionic conductivity exceeding 1 mS/cm at room temperature with Li3BO3 sintering aid enabling densification below 1000C.

title: Method for Manufacturing Thin-Film Solid Electrolyte via Atomic Layer Deposition
abstract: A method for depositing solid electrolyte thin films using plasma-enhanced ALD achieving uniform Li3PO4 films with sub-nanometer thickness control enabling electrolyte layers below 5 micrometers.

title: Composite Cathode Architecture for All-Solid-State Batteries
abstract: A composite cathode with NMC811 active material coated with Li3InCl6 solid electrolyte via mechanofusion achieving interfacial resistance below 10 ohm-cm2 with gradient porosity structure.

title: Dendrite-Suppressing Interlayer for Lithium Metal Anodes
abstract: An artificial SEI comprising alternating LiF and Li3N layers on lithium metal anodes suppressing dendrite growth at current densities up to 5 mA/cm2 enabling cycle life exceeding 1000 cycles.

title: Sulfide-Based Solid Electrolyte with Moisture Stability
abstract: Modified argyrodite Li6PS5Cl with partial S-O substitution achieving 3.2 mS/cm ionic conductivity while maintaining stability at 60% RH for over 24 hours.

title: Bipolar Stacking Architecture for High-Voltage Solid-State Battery Packs
abstract: Bipolar electrode stack design achieving pack-level 450 Wh/kg energy density eliminating conventional current collectors using electron-conducting solid electrolyte interlayers.

title: Roll-to-Roll Manufacturing Process for Solid-State Battery Electrodes
abstract: Continuous roll-to-roll process producing solid-state composite electrodes at speeds exceeding 10 m/min using dry electrode coating with binder-free solid electrolyte integration.

title: Hybrid Solid-Liquid Electrolyte Interface Engineering
abstract: Semi-solid-state design with thin liquid interlayer below 1um between solid electrolyte and cathode achieving 95% capacity retention after 500 cycles at 1C rate.

title: Machine Learning-Guided Discovery of Solid Electrolyte Materials
abstract: Computational framework combining DFT with graph neural networks screening 50000 compounds identifying 12 novel compositions with predicted conductivity above 5 mS/cm.

title: Pressure-Free Sintering Method for Oxide Solid Electrolytes
abstract: Flash sintering for LLZO achieving over 98% relative density in under 30 seconds without mechanical pressure reducing energy consumption by 70% vs conventional sintering.

title: All-Solid-State Sodium-Ion Battery with NASICON Electrolyte
abstract: Solid-state sodium-ion battery using Na3Zr2Si2PO12 NASICON with 2.8 mS/cm conductivity achieving 120 mAh/g with Na3V2PO43 cathode and hard carbon anode.

title: Self-Healing Solid Electrolyte for Extended Cycle Life
abstract: Polymer-ceramic composite with dynamic covalent bonds enabling autonomous crack repair maintaining conductivity above 0.5 mS/cm after mechanical damage.

title: 3D-Printed Solid-State Battery Architecture
abstract: Additive manufacturing for 3D-structured solid-state batteries with interdigitated electrodes achieving 5x areal capacity vs planar designs at 2C rate capability.

title: Low-Temperature Solid-State Battery for Aerospace
abstract: Solid-state battery maintaining over 80% capacity at -40C using Li3YCl6 halide electrolyte with engineered grain boundaries for satellite and UAV applications.

title: Recycling Process for Solid-State Battery Materials
abstract: Hydrometallurgical recycling achieving over 95% recovery of Li La Zr from LLZO electrolyte generating recyclable Li2CO3 and La2O3 precursors.

title: Solid-State Battery Management System with Impedance Spectroscopy
abstract: Integrated BMS using in-situ EIS for real-time state-of-health monitoring detecting incipient delamination and void formation at interfaces in solid-state cells.

title: Flexible Solid-State Micro-Battery for Wearable Devices
abstract: Flexible thin-film solid-state battery achieving 500 uAh/cm2 with less than 5% capacity loss after 10000 bending cycles at 5mm radius using LiPON on polymer substrate.

title: Interface Buffer Layer for Sulfide-Oxide Electrolyte Integration
abstract: Gradient buffer layer enabling sulfide-oxide bilayer architecture combining 5 mS/cm bulk conductivity with electrochemical stability to 5V.

title: Solid-State Lithium-Sulfur Battery with Garnet Electrolyte
abstract: All-solid-state Li-S battery using LLZTO garnet achieving 800 mAh/g sulfur utilization over 200 cycles with inherent polysulfide shuttle blocking.

title: Scalable Dry Room-Free Assembly for Solid-State Batteries
abstract: Manufacturing process eliminating dry room needs using moisture-stable oxide electrolytes and in-line sealing reducing manufacturing cost by estimated 30%.
